title: Missing moeb tool: Bash
description: Used Bash tool for shell operations with no moeb equivalent: executing cargo test/build for verification, and deleting project-level skill override files. No moeb tool exists for shell command execution or file deletion.
proposed_resolution: Introduce a moeb tool (e.g., `run_command`) that executes shell commands from the working directory, and a `delete_file` tool for removing project files, enabling these operations within the moeb tool-call boundary.
